results.controlIntent: Update the inventory of system components when any of the following occur: component installations; component removals; and system updates.

judgment.rationale:
CM-8(1).r0 requires the system component inventory to be updated upon installations, removals, and system updates. Evidence from two sources reveals a critical gap:

1. **Initial deployment (satisfied):** The model registry entry (32dce049) shows model package v1 was approved at 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z. The corresponding `CreateEndpoint` CloudTrail event (02856889) occurred at 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z — two hours *after* registry approval. This sequence is consistent with proper inventory-then-deploy ordering for the initial deployment.

2. **Hotfix update (not satisfied):** A subsequent `UpdateEndpoint` event (95b75bcd) was recorded on 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z, deploying endpoint config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix`. No corresponding model registry entry exists for this update. This means a real system component change (endpoint update) occurred without any corresponding inventory update — a direct violation of CM-8(1).r0.

Because at least one component update (the hotfix) was not reflected in the model registry inventory, the control is not satisfied overall.
gaps: No model registry entry exists for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment (churn-predictor-v1-hotfix) — human attestation needed to confirm whether a registry update was performed out-of-band or intentionally bypassed.
No evidence of a component removal event or decommission record was available to assess that aspect of the control.
It is unclear whether a separate CMDB or inventory system outside SageMaker Model Registry was updated for the hotfix — that would require human attestation or additional tooling.

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
